messages.subject: Include a background with geom_rect
parts:
Dear all:

I am working on making a graphic with a background with geom_rect. The
idea is to plot time series variables which are under different
regimes. For each Regime I want to use a different background colour.
Actually a similar example of what I want to do is on the book from
Wickham (2009) as follows:

(unemp <- qplot(date, unemploy, data=economics, geom="line", xlab =
"", ylab = "No. unemployed (1000s)"))
presidential <- presidential[-(1:3), ]
yrng <- range(economics$unemploy)
xrng <- range(economics$date)
unemp + geom_rect(aes(NULL, NULL, xmin = start, xmax = end, fill =
party), ymin = yrng[1], ymax = yrng[2], data = presidential) +
scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(c("blue", "red"), 0.2))

My code is the following:


### generate non-actual-data
##Prices data
Time<-rep(c(1:250),2)
Price1<-rnorm(250)
Price2<-rnorm(250)
Price<-c(Price1,Price2)
Region1<-rep("Region 1",250)
Region2<-rep("Region 2", 250)
Region<-c(Region1, Region2)
Prices_EQ<-data.frame(Time, Price, Region)
## Regimes data
Number<-(1:31)
reg<-c("LOP", "Equilibrium")
regi<-rep(reg,15)
Regime<-c(regi,"LOP")
Minimum<-
c(1,36,42,43,73,76,77,78,87,93,94,100,101,105,107,116,118,146,147,149,160,166,178,180,182,183,194,215,219,220,221)
Maximum<-
c(36,42,43,73,76,77,78,87,93,94,100,101,105,107,116,118,146,147,149,160,166,178,180,182,183,194,215,219,220,221,250)
Number_Periods<-
c(35,6,1,30,3,1,1,9,6,1,6,1,4,2,9,2,28,1,2,11,6,12,2,2,1,11,21,4,1,1,30)
Regimes_EQ<-data.frame(Number, Regime, Minimum, Maximum,
Number_Periods)

#### generates the graphic

(Plot_EQ<- qplot(Time, Price, data=Prices_EQ, geom="line",
colour=Region))
yrng <- range(Prices_EQ$Price)
xrng <- range(Prices_EQ$Time)
Plot_EQ + geom_rect(aes(NULL, NULL, xmin = Minimum, xmax = Maximum,
fill = Regime), ymin = yrng[1], ymax = yrng[2], data = Regimes_EQ)
+ scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(c("blue", "red"), 0.2))

The problem is that I get the error message " arguments imply
differing number of rows: 31, 500", which I assume is because in the
data "Prices_EQ" the number of rows is 500, and in the data
"Regimes_EQ" the number of rows is 31. I do not see where is my
mistake. I revised the data from the example provided in the book from
book from Wickham (2009) and the only difference I see is that such an
example uses the time in date format, while I am using just numbers.
Could it be that at some point I have to specify that the variable
"Time" is continuous and not an index. Or might it be because I am
using the option "colour=Region". For instance if I add the option
"colour=Region" inside the geom_rect function so as to have:

Plot_EQ + geom_rect(aes(NULL, NULL, xmin = Minimum, xmax = Maximum,
fill = Regime, colour=NA), ymin = yrng[1], ymax = yrng[2], data =
Regimes_EQ)
+ scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(c("blue", "red"), 0.2))


Then I get rectangles showing the regimes, nonetheless they are not
transparent. Furthermore, on the labels for the "Regions" I get an
extra region called "NA".

Thanks for your help,

Best regards,

Sergio René

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: Include a background with geom_rect
parts:
Hi Sergio,
The way ggplot works is that anything set in the ggplot() or qplot()
call is the default for all subsequent elements. Since you set color =
Region in the qplot() call, geom_rect was looking for a Region
variable. To solve this, set color = NULL in the geom_rect call, just
as you already did for x and y:
Plot_EQ + geom_rect(aes(NULL, NULL, colour = NULL, xmin = Minimum,

xmax = Maximum,
fill = Regime), ymin = yrng[1], ymax = yrng[2], data = Regimes_EQ) +
scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(c("blue", "red"), 0.2))
